properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 14 at 7:37PM MDT until August 14 at 10:30PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
FFWBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Washington County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 1030 PM MDT.

* At 737 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
0.5 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts
up to 1 inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, gulches,
roads, and poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Arickaree School, Anton and Elba.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
North Fork Arikaree River, Jack Creek, Arikaree River and Gordon
Creek.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 14 at 7:10PM MDT until August 14 at 10:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 14 at 7:03PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 703 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from 5 miles east of Elbert to near Thurman,
or extending from 41 miles west of Limon to 34 miles northeast of
Limon, moving north at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Limon, Elbert, Kiowa, Simla, Genoa, Matheson, Cedar Point and
Fondis.
